sloka: निदर्शयस्वात्मबलं समुद्यतं कुरुष्व सर्वायुधसायकव्ययम्।न लक्ष्मणस्यैत्य हि बाणगोचरं त्वमद्य जीवन् सबलो गमिष्यसि ।। ६.८७.३१ ।।
transliteration: nidarśayasvātmabalaṁ samudyataṁ kuruṣva sarvāyudhasāyakavyayam।na lakṣmaṇasyaitya hi bāṇagocaraṁ tvamadya jīvan sabalo gamiṣyasi ।। 6.87.31 ।।

translations.english: 'Display your uplifted strength; expend all your weapons and shafts. For once come within the range of Lakshmana's arrows, you shall not this day go back alive with your army.'
